Topic.label: Grouping Data and Estimating the Mean from Grouped Data

Question: Which statement correctly compares the mean estimated using class midpoints with the actual mean of the original data? ( )

Choices.B: There may be an error because the specific data values within each class are lost after grouping.
Choices.C: The estimated mean must be too high.

Solution: After grouping, the class midpoint replaces each data value in that class, so the specific values are lost. Thus, the result is only an estimate and may be too high or too low.
